headline: 4 contracts catalogued on Robinhood Chain (chainId 4663): 1 ZkLighter proxy vault, 1 upgradeable implementation, 1 deposit router, 1 collateral token; on-chain reads blocked (chain not in DeFiPunkd API).

findings.text: D1: Robinhood Chain block explorer (robinhoodchain.blockscout.com) confirmed existence of implementation address 0x82DE5B1161C93afDFE21bA0D5343f01Cd7401d90. Direct name-tag search endpoint not accessible; no searchHandler URL available for Robinhood Chain Blockscout. Proxy address 0x94bab9693ba2f6358507effcbd372b0660afff9d corroborated via Bitquery docs and DeFiLlama.

D2: No official 'Deployed Contracts' page found under lighter.xyz or robinhoodchain.lighter.xyz docs. The Bitquery documentation at docs.bitquery.io/docs/blockchain/robinhood/lighter-perp-dex-api/ serves as the most authoritative public contract map, listing 4 addresses with roles. protocol_metadata.deployed_contracts_doc set to null pending a first-party address registry.
D3: No audit links recorded in protocol.audit_links. No audit PDFs discovered via search or website fetch. unknowns[] entry added.

D4: protocol.github is (none recorded). DeFiLlama adapter GitHub links (DefiLlama/dimension-adapters/blob/master/fees/lighter-rh and dexs/lighter-rh) were blocked by domain permissions. No Lighter protocol source repo discovered. unknowns[] entry added.

D5: Single chain (Robinhood Chain, chainId 4663). All 4 addresses are on this chain. Robinhood Chain is not in the DeFiPunkd API supported chainId list, blocking /api/contract/read and /api/safe/owners calls.

D6: ZkLighter proxy (0x94bab969...) is a rollup contract, not a factory. Markets are created via CreateMarket events but no child pool addresses are enumerated on-chain in the traditional factory pattern. No factory children to discover.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: ZkLighter proxy → vault/other (rollup contract holding user margin); implementation → other (upgradeable logic); deposit router → router; USDG → token. Historical implementations truncated (partial addresses only) recorded in unknowns[].

D8: All 4 admin_addresses[] entries trace to the Bitquery docs fetch (evidence index 0) and corroborated by DeFiLlama (evidence index 1) and Blockscout (evidence index 2). Truncated historical implementation addresses (0x1be72833…, 0xe470e41c…, 0xda2b59ff…) recorded in unknowns[] as D8 entries — snippet-only sightings.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked the protocol website, Bitquery's authoritative Robinhood Chain developer docs, DeFiLlama, and the Robinhood Chain Blockscout explorer. 4 addresses catalogued. No first-party deployments doc, no GitHub, no audits found. DeFiPunkd read API cannot be used (Robinhood Chain chainId 4663 not supported), so on-chain state reads are deferred to future runs once chain support is added or via direct explorer queries.

evidence.shows: Authoritative contract map: ZkLighter proxy 0x94bab9693ba2f6358507effcbd372b0660afff9d, current implementation 0x82DE5B1161C93afDFE21bA0D5343f01Cd7401d90, USDG token 0x5fc5360d0400a0fd4f2af552add042d716f1d168, deposit router 0x8062df5b3220ad1f528365650a3eb3e8c7b0dad1. Also confirms proxy delegates to implementation modules (upgradeable pattern) and documents rollup architecture (commit/verify/execute batch lifecycle).

Protocol operates solely on Robinhood Chain; TVL $71M in USDG; DeFiLlama methodology confirms TVL counts tokens deposited into the Lighter ZK rollup contract; confirms LIT as native token; GitHub adapter links for fees/lighter-rh and dexs/lighter-rh.
Robinhood Chain Blockscout confirms address 0x82DE5B1161C93afDFE21bA0D5343f01Cd7401d90 exists on Robinhood Chain (current ZkLighter implementation as of August 21 2026 upgrade per Bitquery docs).
Protocol website confirms Lighter is live on Robinhood Chain as a perpetuals trading venue; meta description: 'Trade perpetuals with unmatched efficiency and security'.

protocol_metadata.about: Lighter Robinhood Perps is the perpetual-futures DEX integrated into Robinhood Wallet on Robinhood Chain (Arbitrum-based L2, mainnet live July 1 2026). Users post USDG (Global Dollar stablecoin) as margin from their Robinhood Wallet; funds are locked in a ZkLighter rollup contract on-chain while trading, matching, positions, and liquidations are processed inside Lighter's zero-knowledge rollup engine. The protocol generates SNARK proofs for order matching and liquidations, posting batch-lifecycle events (commit, verify, execute) roughly once per minute. Revenue is split 50/50 between Lighter and Robinhood; LIT is Lighter's native governance token, with $11M committed to Robinhood community incentives.
